P3.title: Inspect symlink components before collapsing dot-dot, as advertised
P3.body: no_links applies abspath before inspecting components, erasing lexical-link/.. and allowing a writer to create a fresh normalized sibling despite the README/fresh_output promise to reject lexical symlinks before resolution. Reproduced with run_checks in both modes. Protected inputs remain unchanged and the normalized target stays fresh/outside; this is an advertised-contract mismatch, not an overwrite escape. Inspect lexical components first, or consistently narrow the contract; refresh dependent package bindings and obtain a new complete review.
